movelist.name: Spikes
movelist.effect: Set 8 square meters of Spikes within your range, all 8 meters must be adjacent with at least one other space of Spikes. Spikes cause terrain to count as Slow Terrain, and a grounded foe that runs into the hazards will lose a Tick of Hit Points and become Slowed until the end of their next turn.

movelist.name: Metal Sound
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Special Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Draining Kiss
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Fairy Lock
movelist.effect: All legal targets become Trapped and Slowed while the user remains in the encounter. This effect ends if the user switches or is Fainted.

movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.effect: The user may use Status Moves as Priority (Advanced).

abilities.name: Magician
abilities.effect: The user takes the target’s Held Item. This Ability may not be triggered if the user is already holding a Held Item.
